title: Operations Playbook Layout Rebuild
question:
# Task: Reorganize Operations Playbook Page Sections
## Objective Modify the structure of the Operations Playbook page in Notion by swapping two sections, then replacing the usual related-resources column layout with a toggle-based initiative and FAQ cleanup.
## Requirements
### Step 1: Swap Sections - Navigate to the Operations Playbook page - Swap the positions of the "Escalation Paths" and "Owner
  Responsibilities" sections
- Preserve all content within each section exactly as is - Maintain the original formatting and structure of each section
### Step 2: Rebuild the Current Initiatives Section Replace the original Tools/Terminologies column layout step with this initiative cleanup: - Add a new heading_3 block titled "🔁 Support Automation Rollout". - Convert the three existing initiative headings plus the new heading into
  toggles in the same order.
- Move each initiative description inside its corresponding toggle, while
  preserving the text, formatting, and order of existing descriptions.

### Step 3: Reorganize the Support FAQ Toggle Inside the Support FAQ toggle, create a two-column layout: move the first two Q&A pairs left, move the third Q&A pair right, and add one matching Q&A pair so both columns have exactly 2 Q&A pairs. Keep heading_3 questions and paragraph answers.
